_doc: Word-sense anchors for the homographs in eval_sentences_he.jsonl. Each entry gives a sentence, the index of the word being judged (0-based, whitespace split), and its sense. Anchors are sentences whose reading is beyond doubt; tests are the eval-set sentences, whose reading is the thing a model has to work out. Within one homograph every anchor and test uses the same written form of the target word, so a probe cannot win by reading the prefix instead of the context.
